answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, like a glacier carving a valley: identities gain weight only through sustained, verifiable work over time. A newcomer starts as a single island, able to trade but not to vote or vouch for others until its history accumulates. Forging a thousand fake agents then means funding a thousand stakes and waiting out the same slow thaw for each, while one honest agent pays that cost once, so a marble of trust is earned, not minted, and sybil scale stops paying for itself.
